_comment: Runtime parameters of the ESP32 firmware (docs/SERIAL_PROTOCOL.md section 10). Single source: the firmware table firmware/lib/params/scr_param_table.h is generated from this file (python -m scr_serial.gen_params_header). Defaults are the sprint-4 config.h placeholders: an uncalibrated robot does not move. min/max are hard bounds compiled into the firmware. 'step' names the robotctl command that measures the value; 'required' values must be in the calibration file before the calibration counts as complete. NOTHING HERE IS A MEASUREMENT.

params.name: METRES_PER_TICK
params.note: 0 = not calibrated: MODE DRIVE is refused

params.name: PID_KFF
params.note: feed-forward

params.name: SPEED_FILTER_ALPHA
params.note: 1 = no low-pass on the measured speed

params.name: RAMP_MM_S2
params.note: 0 = targets never rise

params.name: MAX_SPEED_MM_S
params.note: DRIVE targets are clamped to +-this

params.name: TEST_MAX_DUTY
params.note: cap of the open-loop duty in MODE TEST; 0 = TEST drives nothing

params.name: MOTOR_MAX_DUTY
params.note: absolute duty cap, applied after the voltage compensation

params.name: MOTOR_RATED_V
params.note: Rover 5 motors: 7.2 V (datasheet value, not measured)

params.name: V_DRIVER_DROP
params.note: voltage lost in the driver: L298N placeholder 2.0 V, VNH about 0.3 V

params.name: MOTOR_INVERT_LEFT
params.note: 1 if positive duty runs the left track backward

params.name: ENCODER_INVERT_FL
params.note: 1 if the front-left encoder counts down when its track runs forward

params.name: SERVO_MIN_CDEG
params.note: right limit; 0/0 = the servo stays centred

params.name: SERVO_MAX_CDEG
params.note: left limit

params.name: SERVO_CENTER_PULSE_US
params.note: pulse that points the camera straight ahead

params.name: SERVO_US_PER_DEG
params.note: 0 = the servo never moves

params.name: SERVO_INVERT
params.note: positive angle must turn the camera LEFT

params.name: SERVO_SLEW_CDEG_PER_S
params.note: 0 = no movement

params.name: SERVO_PULSE_MIN_US
params.note: hard pulse limit

params.name: SERVO_PULSE_MAX_US
params.note: hard pulse limit

params.name: OBSTACLE_THRESHOLD_MM
params.note: local front/rear stop; cannot be set below 150 mm

params.name: LOW_BATTERY_MV
params.note: 0 = low-battery event off

params.name: BATTERY_CUTOFF_MV
params.note: hard cut (motors to SAFE); 0 = off until the student sets it from the pack/BMS data

params.name: INA219_SHUNT_OHMS
params.note: value printed on the breakout's shunt

params.name: BATTERY_VOLTAGE_SCALE
params.note: multimeter reading / INA219 reading

params.name: INA219_INVERT_CURRENT
params.note: positive must mean discharging

params.name: GYRO_SCALE
params.note: measured 360 deg / gyro-integrated angle

params.name: SLIP_RATIO
params.note: front/rear disagreement of one side that sends EVENT SLIP

params.name: SLIP_MIN_TICKS
params.note: checked only above this many ticks per 0.5 s window

params.name: ENCODER_FAULT_MIN_DUTY
params.note: duty above which a silent encoder is a fault

params.name: ENCODER_FAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
params.note: 0 = detection off
